		icon = generic_political_discourse
		visible = {
			hidden_trigger = { COLDWAR_CHL_is_scenario = yes }
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_rupture_resolved }
			}
			hidden_trigger = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_intervention_prepared }
			}
		}
		available = { COLDWAR_CHL_can_prepare_intervention = yes }
		cost = 100
		days_remove = 90
		days_re_enable = 1
		complete_effect = {
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_CHL_can_prepare_intervention = yes }
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_intervention_in_progress
				}
			}
		}
		cancel_trigger = {
			NOT = { COLDWAR_CHL_intervention_context = yes }
		}
		cancel_effect = {
			hidden_effect = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_intervention_in_progress }
		}
		remove_effect = {
			effect_tooltip = {
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CHL.5 }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						COLDWAR_CHL_intervention_context = yes
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_intervention_in_progress
						NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_rupture_event_seen }
					}
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_intervention_prepared
					COLDWAR_CHL_trigger_event_rupture = yes
				}
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CHL_intervention_in_progress
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 0 }
	}
}
